dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored rings with high-contrast sharp transitions from light-intensity perimeters to dark-intensity interiors, most prominent in the dorsal-mid section where several annuli overlap to form a lattice-like geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, solid high-intensity (white/light-gray) blobs dispersed across the lateral flank, with a higher concentration of smaller, asymmetric clusters near the posterior region and lower ventral edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form a near-equilateral triangle in the upper-mid region, while several smaller high-intensity blobs along the flank form a linear-oblique chain extending toward the flipper.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast delineation of five digital claws on the visible right pectoral flipper, appearing as low-intensity vertical bands against a light-intensity background.
